senses.zh_definition: Emmett：英语姓氏，也用作名字；出现在马来语句子中时，可作为人名专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: An English surname also used as a given name; a proper name when used in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang juga digunakan sebagai nama diri seseorang. Huraian ini ialah penerangan editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 输入未提供 DBP 释义，本次检索也未能核实其为正式马来语词条，因此不能标记为 official。人名通常写作 Emmett，首字母大写；中文可音译为“埃米特”，具体人物应沿用其通行译名。以下搭配及例句为人名用法示例，不代表已验证的高频搭配。姓名用法参见 [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/emmett)。

etymology.historical_story: Emmett belongs to English naming history rather than a demonstrated Malay word family. Its surname origins are multiple: some families are associated with Emmot near Colne in Lancashire, others with Emmett in Devon, and another origin involves Emmot, a familiar form of Emma. A shared modern spelling therefore does not establish one ancestral story for every bearer. See the [Guild of One-Name Studies](https://one-name.org/name_profile/emmett/).
